items.question: How is the project funded?
items.answer: Through sponsorships and donations, held by a foundation. Maintainers are volunteers unless a sponsor funds their time, and we say which.

items.question: Can I use it commercially?
items.answer: Yes. It is released under a permissive licence with no commercial restriction.

items.question: How do I become a maintainer?
items.answer: Contribute steadily for a few months and ask. The governance document lists exactly what we look for.

pages.title: About
pages.markdown:
## Our story

Your Brand started as a weekend project to make deployments boring. It was released under a permissive licence in 2018, and the first outside contribution arrived within an hour.

## How we work

Decisions are made in public, in issues and in the monthly design call. Anyone can propose a change; maintainers review and merge. The governance document says exactly how a contributor becomes a maintainer.

## Where we are going

A stable 2.0, a smaller core and a plugin interface that keeps the project small as it grows.
